title: rust-mutants trace v1
description: One line of a recording: an envelope of sequence number and moment around a typed record. A trace is diagnostic exhaust and never evidence (ADR 0002); what it is for is telling a reader why a run behaved as it did.

process-exit.description: The one way a process that exited by itself did so.

trace-context.description: The invocation boundary this engine recording belongs to. Standalone runs bind their run and canonical Cargo build selection; njutest-owned recordings bind one exact configured-build ledger row. Toolchain and resolved-target evidence are separate from this selection digest.

step-limit-notice.description: A runtime notice correlated to one execution by its fresh nonce and checked against the selected catalog, mutant, and exact N+1 boundary.

step-protocol-failure.description: The exact stage at which the nonce-correlated, structurally verified step side channel failed closed.

timeout_ms.description: The bound on the whole execution; for one watched for progress, the ceiling over it.

quiet_ms.description: How long the process could go without raising its step count, where it was watched for that; null where it was not.

stopped.description: How the process came to a stop. The closed tagged union cannot express contradictory flags or attach a process exit to a supervisor stop.

raised.description: How many step boundaries the process had raised. Above zero says the allowance would have ended this and the clock got there first, which is a race one machine wins and another does not. Zero says no boundary was raised, so no allowance could have ended it. Null says the state could not be read, which is not a count of zero.
How many step boundaries the process had raised before it went quiet for a whole window. Null says the state could not be read, which is not a count of zero.

measured.description: Which whole run of the target with nothing active the record was measured on: the baseline routing rests on, or an original-code control run to confirm a kill.

passed.description: The tests that run passed, which is what the record is the reach of.

summary.description: What the run's own summary said, in the protocol it answered in: under libtest, a comparison stands only where `tests_run` equals the number of names in `passed`; a custom harness prints no summary; a remembered baseline's run is not here to say.

reached_sites.description: Every mutant site anything of the target reached.

entered_bodies.description: Every branch body anything of the target entered, by the marker at its first statement.

infected_sites.description: Every mutation anything of the target saw its guard's two branches differ over.

infected.description: How many distinct mutations anything of it saw its guard's two branches differ over.

entered.description: How many distinct items anything of it entered the body of.

alone.description: Whether it ran with nothing else the run started running beside it, which is what a confirming retry does.

lingered.description: Whether the harness had already answered when the clock ended the process, so the verdict is the harness's.
